description: IRS Schedule B (Form 1040) — V1 一般案件填表器規格

inputs.description: Tax Year: 申報之稅務年度

一般利息明細。結構包含 statement_issuer_name (string | null), source_document_type, source_box, payer_name, payer_reported_amount (Decimal), tax_character (TAXABLE_INTEREST | TAX_EXEMPT_INTEREST | UNKNOWN), is_series_ee_or_i_interest.
一般股利明細。結構包含 statement_issuer_name (string | null), source_document_type, payer_name, ordinary_dividends (Decimal), qualified_dividends (Decimal), exempt_interest_dividends (Decimal).
Part III Line 7a (1): 是否在海外擁有金融帳戶權限或利益
Part III Line 7a (2): 是否被要求申報 FBAR
Part III Line 7b: FBAR 國家名稱列表
Part III Line 8: 是否涉及海外信託分配或為 grantor/transferor

V1 特殊案件偵測旗標。包含 has_nominee_distribution, has_accrued_interest, has_oid, has_abp_adjustment, has_market_discount, has_seller_financed_mortgage, has_form_8814, has_tax_exempt_bond_premium, has_contingent_payment_debt.
Form 1099-B/Form 8949 中包含 accrued market discount 的交易明細。結構包含 payer_name, proceeds (Decimal), cost_basis (Decimal), accrued_market_discount (Decimal).
